lead: Siddaramaiah is an Indian politician, born on 12 August 1948 in Mysuru district.
As of 2026, he is 78 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly and Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly.
The sections that follow break down Siddaramaiah's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Siddaramaiah — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Siddaramaiah was born on 12 August 1948 in Mysuru district, and holds Indian nationality.
He is recorded as speaking Kannada and English.

sections.heading: Siddaramaiah — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (1983–1989), Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (1994–1999), Deputy Chief Minister of Karnataka (1996–1999), Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (2004–2007), Deputy Chief Minister of Karnataka (2004–2005) and Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (2008–2018). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
